capabilities: Ask configured local agent CLIs questions about the vault
Search the vault and send bounded evidence excerpts to the agent
Select text and request explanations, ADR lookup, review suggestions, or comments
Add editable AI or manual review comments with citations that jump to source headings
Interrupt agent processes, including child process trees, on Windows
disambiguation: Not a built-in chat assistant; it shells out to user-configured local agent CLI commands rather than providing its own model.
extras: Desktop-only. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. If the chosen agent uses a remote model, prompt and evidence excerpts may be sent to that provider.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to query AI agents about vault content with bounded evidence, citations, and review comments stored in the source notes.

relations.evidence: For Hermes, a selected model is passed with -m.

summary: Desktop plugin that sends questions about a Markdown vault to locally configured AI agent CLIs and keeps evidence-linked review notes.
